title: Patriots vs. Seahawks Monday injury report: Ben Brown ruled out ahead of opener
game: New England Patriots at Seattle Seahawks
materialFindings: Center Ben Brown did not travel and is officially OUT for the opener after a second straight DNP, converting a prior availability watch into a confirmed interior-line absence.

TreVeyon Henderson missed practice again with the ankle injury and has now been sidelined for roughly two weeks, materially increasing the probability that Rhamondre Stevenson carries the lead-back role.
Christian Barmore returned to full participation after being a DNP on the first report, materially improving New England's defensive-line availability outlook.
Seattle safety Nick Emmanwori remained limited and Ty Okada remained out, so the Seahawks' safety-depth concern persists rather than resolving.
No side, moneyline, total, prop, score prediction, or conviction statement was published or inferred.
